newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber closes higher on adjustments.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber closes higher on adjustments.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were quoted higher again at the close on technical adjustment, but trading remained quiet due to a lack of consumer demand, traders said.
"There's been no sales heard of anywhere," said a trader. "There were inquiries from China but the asking price was by local producers was a bit high."
At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted March RSS1 buyer at 301.50 cents ($1.21) a kg, up half cent from Wednesday. March SMR 20 was also up half cent at 296.
Traders offered drum latex at 236 cents a kg, SMR CV at 358, SMR L at 338, SMR 5 at 305, SMR 10 at 295 and SMR 20 at 294.
The INRO five-day average was 232.20 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Feb 26 from 233.70 on Feb 25. The daily indicator was at 231.85 against 230.99.
